title: Use CASE WHEN for Conditional Aggregation
learning_objective: Learn how CASE WHEN can count or sum only rows that match a condition.

tutorial.explanation: Conditional aggregation uses CASE WHEN inside SUM. Matching rows contribute a value, and non-matching rows contribute 0.
tutorial.syntax: SUM(CASE WHEN condition THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS monday_units
tutorial.mental_model: CASE labels each row with the number to add. SUM adds those labels across the group.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) = 1 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS monday_units FROM orders;
guided_example.explanation: Monday rows add quantity. Other rows add zero.

practice.prompt: Return total Tuesday units as tuesday_units.
practice.expected_query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM CAST(order_date AS DATE)) = 2 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS tuesday_units FROM orders;
